description: The cards that work best with a card, ranked, each with what they share. Give `with` to ask instead whether two particular cards work together, how strongly, and why.

card.description: A card name or oracle id.

limit.description: How many synergies (10 by default; at most 10 without an API key or a connected account).

with.description: A second card, to judge the pair.

name: card_synergy
title: Card synergies
